tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Certificate Verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, and development builds are not an exception: there is no configuration in which verification is turned off for development. This sits alongside the separate recorded decision to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception even for internal services.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
